note: What gets decided, and when. Every date is pre-registered - decisions are made on the evidence named here, not on the mood of the day.

items.title: Scheduled review
items.what: Reads the whole board: every gate scorecard, gamma equity, benched-0.618 progress, drawdowns, era health.

items.title: Fib-window era rotation
items.what: The anchored window rolls to a new fixed start (recorded via win_anchor stamps). Expect a small stamped burst of newly visible legs - scheduled evolution, not drift.

items.title: Breakeven twin race verdict
items.what: Two weeks of paired sticky fills: does breakeven@+0.75R beat the pure ladder at gamma's wall-capped trades? Backtest said no for far targets; the wall may differ.

items.title: Pipeline verdict: fixed-start vs rolling
items.what: THE deciding test of the anchored (fixed-start) window deployed 2026-07-20: post-fix live fills vs the engine's own simulation on the same days, all level books. Match => machine verified end-to-end (fixed start stays). Mismatch => hunt the residual defect on a now-deterministic engine. Context: test 21 showed the old rolling window earned MORE in clean simulation (+re-touches) but its live reality diverged catastrophically (6% win vs 21% simulated) and it can never be verified. Revert = one commit, with evidence. Also: did the Aug-1 era rotation behave (small stamped fill-burst, then stability)?

items.title: Gamma weather-table verdicts
items.what: Each v140 gate's shadow scorecard (runs-aligned, vix-high, day-breaker) plus the v142 VIX floor: keep what saves money, revert what costs it.

items.title: Gamma last chance: best-candidates rebirth bar
items.what: Owner's last-chance protocol (2026-07-28). Trade book stays LOCKED. The shadow book runs the fixed mechanics (latched breaker, 10:30 bell) and the best-candidates study defines a pre-registered subset (near-flip / strong-wall / dte-band / hour filters). REBIRTH BAR: the subset shows >= +0.10R/trade over >= 30 shadow fills by Sep 1 -> owner may unlock THAT SUBSET ONLY. Otherwise the retirement stands (test 22: 18,288 map-vs-price pairs, zero signal pooled; two bleeding eras). The 🕶 shadow strip on the 🎲 tab shows the running evidence.

items.title: Wall-strength ML re-run
items.what: Re-run the wall-scoring pilot with 4-6 more weeks of fills + counterfactual touches of the walls the engine never trades. First run: no signal (7 days, rank-0 only).

items.title: 0.618 unbench decision
items.what: 75-150 clean shadow fills across 2 eras: unbench if fidelity holds AND the record tracks the canonical same-period line (tracks canonical, not beats zero - 2026 is soft even for the perfect engine).

items.title: Level-trio audition go/no-go
items.what: Judge mainly post-fix (anchored-era) data: do the 0.786s and Defense track their backtest lines? Plus the pre-registered skipped-fill and overnight-gap questions.

items.title: Defense smoothness dial
items.what: Owner preference call with real capital: as-is (max total) vs the two-key gated Book (never a red year, ~Rs80k/yr premium at Rs28L). Tables on the studies board.

items.title: Capital translation + Pocket honesty
items.what: Re-compute per-engine minimums from months of recorded lot data (est. Rs28L all four). Pocket's wave-2 fixes + window anchoring must land before its paper line is trusted.
